title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1, 1.2 Basic Classes of Functions: Calculate the slope of a linear function and interpret its meaning.
summary: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1, 1.2 Basic Classes of Functions: Calculate the slope of a linear function and interpret its meaning.
body: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1, section "1.2 Basic Classes of Functions", prints these objectives: "Calculate the slope of a linear function and interpret its meaning." "Recognize the degree of a polynomial." "Find the roots of a quadratic polynomial." "Describe the graphs of basic odd and even polynomial functions." "Identify a rational function." "Describe the graphs of power and root functions.". The section text says: "We have studied the general characteristics of functions, so now let’s examine some specific classes of functions. We begin by reviewing the basic properties of linear and quadratic functions, and then generalize to include higher-degree polynomials. By combining root functions with polynomials, we can define general algebraic functions and distinguish them from the transcendental functions we examine later in this chapter. We finish the section with examples of piecewise-defined functions and…" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
